name: data-grid
title: Data grid
description: A virtualised, keyboard-navigable grid for very large data sets, with sortable columns and row selection.
a11y: role="grid" with aria-rowcount, aria-colcount, aria-rowindex and aria-colindex so assistive technology knows the full size although only visible rows are in the DOM.
Roving tabindex: one Tab stop; arrow keys move between cells, Home and End go to the row ends, Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End to the first and last cell, PageUp and PageDown move a screenful.
Sortable headers carry aria-sort (ascending, descending, none); Enter or Space on a focused header sorts.
With selectionMode, rows carry aria-selected and Space or a click toggles the focused row; the grid is aria-multiselectable in multiple mode.
The header row stays visible while scrolling; an empty grid shows an empty state.

props.name: columns
props.description: The column definitions: id, header, how to read each cell, width and sortability.

props.name: rows
props.description: All the rows. Only the visible ones are rendered, so tens of thousands are fine.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: Stable id per row, used for selection. Default: the row's position in `rows`.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Row height in px. Every row has the same height; that is what makes virtualising cheap. Default 36.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the scrolling grid, header included. Default 400.

props.name: overscan
props.description: Extra rows rendered above and below the visible ones. Default 5.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Whether rows can be selected: `none` (default), `single` or `multiple`.

props.name: selectedIds
props.description: Controlled selected row ids. Pair with `onSelectedIdsChange`.

props.name: defaultSelectedIds
props.description: Initially selected row ids when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSelectedIdsChange
props.description: Called with the new list of selected row ids.

props.name: defaultSort
props.description: Initial sort when uncontrolled; `null` is unsorted.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called with the new sort, or `null` when sorting is cleared.

props.name: manualSort
props.description: Do not sort in the grid: `rows` arrive already ordered (server-side sorting).
